neighbours.label: ' lacks': an institution or agent lacking a power or resource
fire: Critics say the new oversight board lacks the teeth to punish polluters.
The small clinic lacks the equipment needed for heart surgery.
Unfortunately the city council lacks the legal power to raise taxes.
Experts warn that the treaty lacks any mechanism for enforcement.
The rebel army lacks the air support required to hold the capital.
Because the panel lacks a quorum, no vote can be taken today.
The startup lacks the cash to survive another year without investors.
Observers note that the court lacks jurisdiction over foreign companies.
quiet: Critics say the new oversight board has the teeth to punish polluters.
The small clinic owns the equipment needed for heart surgery.
Fortunately the city council holds the legal power to raise taxes.
Experts note that the treaty includes a mechanism for enforcement.
The rebel army enjoys the air support required to hold the capital.
Because the panel reached a quorum, a vote can be taken today.
The startup raised the cash to survive another year without investors.
Observers note that the court claims jurisdiction over foreign companies.
